description: Wistia's MCP server lets you manage your entire video library from ChatGPT. Upload videos, make bulk updates, manage content access, and check webinar or video performance with quick prompts where you already work. Built-in skills enable you to automate your video and webinar workflows at scale that drive real business growth.
